sourceText: User agreed to upgrade manual milestone_ledger_set/add into automatic planning-write ledger creation, without adding new docs, while preserving the read-only milestone_status boundary.
normalizedOutcome: Planning write commands that receive explicit structured milestones create candidate milestone-ledger.json automatically; prose-only inputs do not create one.
acceptanceClaim: Focused CLI and logic tests show story_create, planner_create_story, and plan_skeleton --write create candidate ledger rows only when structured milestones are supplied.
